subject.title: fix(searxng): fail closed on unresolved base url refs

question: Should an existing SearXNG installation with an explicit `baseUrl` that becomes unavailable continue to use ambient `SEARXNG_BASE_URL`, or should it fail before any request as this PR proposes?
rationale: Both outcomes are technically coherent, but the proposed unconditional fail-closed behavior intentionally changes an existing recovery path and can make a previously working web-search setup stop at runtime.

options.title: Accept fail-closed resolution
options.body: Approve configured `baseUrl` as authoritative, then refresh the branch on current `main` and land the tested resolver change.

options.title: Preserve compatibility fallback
options.body: Keep the current ambient fallback for unavailable explicit values and close or revise this PR rather than changing upgrade behavior implicitly.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed resolution
recommendation.body: Approve configured `baseUrl` as authoritative, then refresh the branch on current `main` and land the tested resolver change.
